subject: Parameter Estimate Confidence Intervals & Multiple Imputation

messages.author: 6f81c58ba9ed02c3
messages.subject: Parameter Estimate Confidence Intervals & Multiple Imputation
parts:
Hello everyone,

Is it possible to obtain the confidence intervals for the unstandardized parameter estimates computed for a model using multiply imputed data? I tried using the parameterEstimates function, but it does not return any numerical information.

Thank you,

Ryan

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Parameter Estimate Confidence Intervals & Multiple Imputation
parts: I tried using the parameterEstimates function

That is not a generic function exported by lavaan, so I use the summary() method to do that with lavaan.mi objects.  

class?lavaan.mi
summary(fit, ci = TRUE)
